US Judge Dismisses Trump Lawsuits Over Election Challenges

A US judge has dismissed two lawsuits filed by Donald Trump. One lawsuit, seeking $14 billion against The Wall Street Journal, was dismissed with the judge describing the claim as 'grasping at straws.' This suit related to a letter concerning Jeffrey Epstein. Another lawsuit sought to block the Alaska Senate race if Democrats won, which a judge also dismissed. Separately, a judge barred the Trump administration from threatening election officials over voter data, rebuking midterm plans.
